In the muck of the Mirewynn swamps, a dorsal fan breaches the water as a powerful tail churns the calm surface. Th e glomunder does 
not make for a subtle hunter, yet even so, many larger predators keep their distance unless desperate, as the large frog-like creature has 
a means of protection wholly unique to the swamps. When cornered by a voracious predator, it will swing its head violently, splashing 
a viscous saliva from its two sinuous tendrils that whip back and forth as it tries to slap and spread a debilitating neurotoxin. Once in 
contact with this thick yellow fluid, extremities fall numb and limp and, before long, the afflicted creature fi nds itself sinking into the 
stagnant water, incapacitated and an easy meal for the amphibious glomunder.

Encountering Glomunder tend to lack wariness from larger 
creatures. If approached amiably, the frog-like creature will 
soon respond in kind and approach playfully, often forgetting 
that its wagging tendrils are harmful to other creatures besides 
its own type. Th is friendly greeting is sadly often met with the 
unmoving paralyzed body of a Traveler, slowly sinking into the 
mud.
Defensive Instinct (1/Day) Frenzied and hurt, the glomunder flails 
desperately.
Reaction - Trigger: When the glomunder is bloodied and in melee 
combat. Response - Wisdom Saving Th row: DC 12, the glomunder. 
Th e glomunder lashes out with its Paralytic Whips and makes an 
attack roll against the nearest enemy creature if within range.
